{{Locations|Pirate Controlled Sector|Uncharted Nebula|nebula=true|LRSmap=ship+nebula|unique=false}}


The intro text for this event varies, and could be any of the following: 
*''As you drift through the nebula an unmarked vessel descends from the clouds and into your wake. Their weapons come online.''
*''A pirate ship pulls out of the ether and hails: "You know what I love about this part of the galaxy? The explorers! You always carry such fine loot." They lock weapons.''
*''As you coast through the nebula a pirate ship matches your course and closes the distance. Better to pick your battleground, but beggars can't be choosers.''
*''A hostile vessel descends from out of the nebula. Combat stations!''
*''You try to read the ID of a ship ahead in the fog, but it's too thick to penetrate. You have your answer when the ship turns, weapons hot!''
**Fight a [[Enemy Ships|Pirate ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]).

==Trivia==
This event is called "NEBULA_PIRATE" in the datafiles.

* This event can never happen. In the files, there is an eventList with the same name as this event, so whenever this event would load (in Uncharted Nebula, as a potential hostile encounter in nebula), the game loads a random event from that eventList instead, listed below.
** [[Boarders: Humans in nebula]]
** [[Boarders: rebels in nebula]]
** [[Empty nebula beacon]]
** [[Pirate smuggler]]
** [[Rebel fight choice in nebula]]
** [[Trade resources in nebula]]
** {{DuplicateEvent|2}} [[Nebula lost ship]]
** {{DuplicateEvent|2}} [[Plasma storm incapacitated ships]]
** [[Rebel fight in nebula]] (which is also another instance of an event having the same name as an eventList)
*** [[Auto-ship fight in nebula]]
*** [[Auto-ship fight in plasma storm]]
*** [[Auto-ship near storage station in nebula]]
*** [[Auto-ship warning in nebula]]
*** [[Boarders: rebels in nebula]]
*** [[Empty nebula beacon]]
*** [[Nebula lost ship]]
*** [[Plasma storm incapacitated ships]]
*** [[Rebel fight choice in nebula]]
*** [[Rebel fight in plasma storm]]
*** [[Trade resources in nebula]]
* If this event were to happen as per normal, although the beacon is in a nebula on the map, the nebula environment will be missing upon arrival due to a missing environment tag.
